2. Use the EXISTING SUPRA updater/LaunchAgent only. Do not create another updater. If it is already running, let it finish; otherwise kickstart the EXISTING com.novaera.supra-autoupdate / existing updater once.

4. Launch exactly one canonical SUPRA instance.
5. Do not manually synthesize an Executive result. Allow the installed one-shot Executive admission closure objective to execute through the SAME SUPRA UI/runtime path.
6. Observe ONLY the resulting EXECUTIVE_OBJECTIVE_* request/receipt in EXISTING ~/NOVA_OS/SUPRA_GRANDE_MISSION_V1/INBOX and OUTBOX.
7. PASS only if the receipt proves:
   EXECUTIVE_OBJECTIVE
   -> OBJECTIVE_ID
   -> RUNTIME_ADMISSION
   -> actual /v1/chat/OpenCode execution
   -> MATERIAL_RESULT or HUMAN_GATE_REQUIRED=YES
   -> same Executive UI return
   -> same objective visible to Runtime Observatory.
8. "Running..." is NOT proof.
9. If it fails, return the FIRST exact runtime/projection failure only. Do not patch further.
10. Publish/update the existing local runtime proof if the existing updater normally does so.
